# 1.2.129 - the player's messenger keeps its rectangle, and a larger box to write in

One stage ships: E130 (tools/stages.json), the owner's two messenger requests made after 1.2.128, on 23 and 24.11.2026.
**E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 are not shipped**, planned 1.2.130. E26 stays 1.3.0. From v1.2.128 (the tag, main
8f059800) to this release commit: three commits on the assembly - the stage row, line COMM's two changes applied
without their screenshots (622cf16d and 6d4ca946 on claude/comm-122), the AUDIT items - and this one.

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code and measured in Chromium on the module's own style sheets,
without Foundry's; none of it has run on a real Foundry or at a table (## Checked).

**A player's messenger window keeps its rectangle** (OWNER-129-CHATRECT, line COMM; the owner: "niech trzyma u graczy
ksztalt prostokata, bez rozszerzania jak teraz").
- Under Stained Glass a player's window followed its content: asked 730 px tall at 1920 x 1080, it was drawn 284 px with
  no message, 565 with three and 1064 with forty, its send form below the screen's foot. The theme's rule that sizes a
  panel to its content (stained-glass.css, "Windows the size of what is in them") left out only the GM's messenger
  window, since 1.2.124.
- The rule now leaves out every messenger window, so a player's keeps the size it opened at (760 x 730, cut to 90% of
  the screen) and its messages scroll inside it. Monokuma Legacy already kept the rectangle; it is unchanged, as is the
  GM's window.

**A larger "Write a message" box** (OWNER-129-WRITEBOX, line COMM; the owner: "Poprawmy write a message (powiekszmy)").
- The box was one line, its text the browser's 13.3 px under messages of 21 px (Stained Glass) and 13 px (Legacy).
- Its text is now the messages' size, through the theme's own variables, so the module's interface scale reaches it. It
  opens three lines tall, grows with what is typed to six, then scrolls (base.css, stained-glass.css,
  `.drpg-messenger-input textarea`). The window keeps its size: the list of messages above gives up the height.
- The growth is `field-sizing: content`, the style sheet's alone: Chromium-based browsers, Foundry's desktop app among
  them, grow the box; a browser without it, Firefox among them, keeps the three lines.
- On a short screen the opening height gives way so that the list still shows two whole messages: three lines from a
  screen 665 px tall up, about one and a half at 600.
- In the player's and the GM's windows, under both themes. Enter, Shift+Enter, a failed send keeping its words and the
  drafts are unchanged (no script of the module changed; scripts/ gains only the two tests).

## Before installing

- **No migration clause is added**, no setting is registered, no GM store is added. **Language**: lang/en.json and
  lang/pl.json have no change in the range (6639 and 7734 keys).
- No glyph added, no console name changed. **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's
  compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364, verified 14.365).

## Repository

- Tests: 2 new registry rows, R8910 (the messenger windows' height under both themes) and R8911 (the write box's size,
  opening and growth), both tier 1, each red on its base and green after; next free R8912. tools/registry.mjs: line
  STG's 1.2.128 range, R8900-R8929 stamped E129, narrowed to the rows it used, R8900-R8909, and R8910-R8919 stamped
  E130.
- audit/harness/probes/129-chatrect.mjs, new: keeps a player's and the GM's messenger windows for the measurements.
  docs/dev/owner129/chatrect/ and writebox/: the measuring scripts and the heights before and after; their 32
  screenshots stay on claude/comm-122.
- The player handbook, English and Polish, says the window keeps its size and describes the box. The other handbooks
  change only their version line.
- audit/AUDIT-1.2.42.md 9.2 gains items 946-947 (LIVE-129-COMM-08, -09).

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.130). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- The sizes were measured on the module's style sheets without Foundry's: whether Foundry v14's own rule for a text box
  outweighs the module's at a real table is not measured (LIVE-129-COMM-09). No `!important` was added.
- A window resized by dragging its corner was not dragged: R8910 reads that no style sheet rule wins the height of a
  messenger window now, so Foundry's resize stands.
- No test presses Enter or Shift+Enter in the box (a tier-1 test would write a message to the world); the handler is
  unchanged. Nor is a player's draft across the Chat and Note tabs held by a test.
- At 1024 x 600 under Stained Glass, while three lines are typed, the list shows one whole message until the text is
  sent.
- **The local gate**: only its press part ran (## Checked); its eight parts that need a Foundry v14 sandbox did not, so
  its verdict is incomplete.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 14 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json, as at 1.2.128.
